name: academic-research-skills
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for academic research skills — CNKI, Google Scholar, ScienceDirect, Web of Science, Nature

plugins.name: cnki-advanced-search
plugins.description: Perform advanced search on CNKI with field filters like author, title, journal, date range, source category (SCI/EI/CSSCI/北大核心). Use when user needs precise filtered search beyond simple keywords.

plugins.name: cnki-download
plugins.description: Download a paper PDF/CAJ from CNKI. Requires user to be logged in. Use when user wants to download a specific paper.

plugins.name: cnki-export
plugins.description: Export paper from CNKI and push to Zotero, or save as RIS file. Use when user wants to save a paper to Zotero or export citation data.

plugins.name: cnki-journal-index
plugins.description: Query journal indexing/inclusion status on CNKI - check which databases include a journal (北大核心, CSSCI, CSCD, SCI, EI, etc.), get impact factors and evaluation data. Use when user asks about a journal's level, indexing, or ranking.

plugins.name: cnki-journal-search
plugins.description: Search for journals/publications on CNKI by name, ISSN, CN, or sponsor. Use when the user wants to find a specific journal or browse publications.

plugins.name: cnki-journal-toc
plugins.description: Browse journal issues, view table of contents, and download original TOC PDF from CNKI. Use when user wants to see papers in a specific journal issue or download the original cover/TOC pages.

plugins.name: cnki-navigate-pages
plugins.description: Navigate CNKI search result pages (next/previous/specific page) or change sort order. Use when user wants to see more results or change sorting.

plugins.name: cnki-paper-detail
plugins.description: Extract full paper details from a CNKI paper page including title, authors, affiliations, abstract, keywords, fund, classification. Use when the user needs detailed information about a specific paper.

plugins.name: cnki-parse-results
plugins.description: Parse current CNKI search results page into structured paper data (title, authors, journal, date, citations). Use after a search has been performed and you need to extract the results.

plugins.name: cnki-search
plugins.description: Search CNKI (中国知网) for papers by keyword. Use when the user wants to find academic papers on a topic.

plugins.name: gs-advanced-search
plugins.description: Perform advanced Google Scholar search with filters - author, journal, date range, exact phrase, title-only. Constructs proper URL parameters from natural language. Use for precise filtered searches.

plugins.name: gs-cited-by
plugins.description: Find papers that cite a given Google Scholar paper. Tracks citation chains using data-cid (cluster ID). Use when user wants to see who cited a specific paper.

plugins.name: gs-export
plugins.description: Export Google Scholar paper(s) to Zotero via BibTeX. Gets citation data from Google Scholar's cite dialog, then pushes to Zotero desktop. Supports single or batch export.

plugins.name: gs-fulltext
plugins.description: Get full-text access links for a Google Scholar paper - PDF, DOI, Sci-Hub, and publisher links. Use when user wants to read or download a paper's full text.

plugins.name: gs-navigate-pages
plugins.description: Navigate Google Scholar search result pages. Use when user wants to see more results or go to a specific page.

plugins.name: gs-search
plugins.description: Search Google Scholar for academic papers by keywords. Returns results with title, authors, journal, year, citation count, and full-text links. Use when the user wants to search Google Scholar.

plugins.name: nature-paper2ppt
plugins.description: Build a complete but efficient Nature-style Chinese PPTX presentation from a scientific paper, preprint, PDF, article text, abstract, figure legends, or reading notes. Use this skill whenever the user asks to make slides/PPT/PPTX for journal club, group meeting, paper sharing, thesis seminar, lab meeting, department report, or academic presentation from a research paper, not only medical papers. It identifies the paper type and argument, selects only the figures needed for the story, writes Chinese slide content and speaker notes, creates the actual .pptx deck, and runs an explicit self-review/corrective revision loop focused on figure quality, text overflow prevention, and non-template visual design before delivery.

plugins.name: nature-polishing
plugins.description: Polish, restructure, or translate academic prose into Nature-leaning English using writing-strategy principles, curated Nature/Nature Communications article patterns, and phrase-level support from Academic Phrasebank. Use whenever the user asks to polish a manuscript paragraph, abstract, introduction, results, discussion, conclusion, title, methods section, or Chinese academic draft for publication-quality English.

plugins.name: nature-reader
plugins.description: Build full-paper Chinese-English side-by-side, figure/table-aware, source-grounded Markdown readers for journal or conference papers from PDF, DOI, arXiv, publisher HTML, or pasted text. Use whenever the user asks to translate or read a paper, make 中英文对照/原文对照/全文翻译解读, extract figures or tables into the right positions, preserve figure/table placement near relevant prose, or keep exact source anchors for every block. This skill must not degrade into a summary-only output unless the user explicitly asks for a summary.

plugins.name: nature-writing
plugins.description: Draft, restructure, or plan Nature-style manuscript sections from author-provided claims, results, figures, notes, or Chinese drafts. Use when the user wants to write or rebuild an abstract, introduction, results narrative, discussion, conclusion, title, or full manuscript argument rather than only polish finished prose.

plugins.name: sd-advanced-search
plugins.description: Advanced search on ScienceDirect with filters like author, journal, year, title, keywords. Use when the user wants filtered academic paper search.

plugins.name: sd-download
plugins.description: Download PDF from ScienceDirect articles. Requires institutional or subscriber access.

plugins.name: sd-export
plugins.description: Export citations from ScienceDirect in RIS, BibTeX, or plain text format. Supports pushing to Zotero.

plugins.name: sd-journal-browse
plugins.description: Browse a journal on ScienceDirect — view info, impact factor, latest articles, and specific issues. Use when the user asks about a journal or wants to browse its contents.

plugins.name: sd-navigate-pages
plugins.description: Navigate pages, change sort order, or adjust results per page on ScienceDirect search results.

plugins.name: sd-paper-detail
plugins.description: Extract full metadata from a ScienceDirect article page (abstract, authors, keywords, DOI, references, PDF link). Use when the user wants details about a specific paper.

plugins.name: sd-parse-results
plugins.description: Re-parse the currently open ScienceDirect search results page. Internal skill used by other skills.

plugins.name: sd-search
plugins.description: Search for academic papers on ScienceDirect. Use when the user wants to find papers by keyword on ScienceDirect/Elsevier.

plugins.name: wos-dom
plugins.description: Web of Science DOM structure reference for browser automation

plugins.name: wos-download
plugins.description: Download PDF full text for a WoS paper via publisher links.

plugins.name: wos-export
plugins.description: Export WoS records to Zotero, RIS, BibTeX, or Excel.

plugins.name: wos-navigate-pages
plugins.description: Navigate to a specific page of WoS search results, or load more results from the last search.

plugins.name: wos-paper-detail
plugins.description: Get detailed information for a paper by WoS ID (e.g., WOS:000779183600001).

plugins.name: wos-parse-results
plugins.description: Parse search results from the current WoS results page or API response. Internal skill used by other skills.

plugins.name: wos-search
plugins.description: Search Web of Science by topic, author, title, DOI, or advanced query. Supports edition/database filtering and sort.
